about: Shared test vectors for the root-search guard (docs/root-search-guard.md), run by the Python check (scripts/test_root_search_guard.py); the held OpenCode port (branch feat/root-search-guard-2) must pass them before it ships. Replace @REPOS@ and @HOME@ in every string with the environment below (a neutral layout, nobody's real one). `extra_roots` is the setting's list of extra root folders (each with every ancestor a root); `repos` are the folders that hold a .git entry; `folders` gives the subfolder names a listing of that folder returns (any other folder lists none); listing a folder in `unreadable` fails (an OSError); `glob_honours_gitignore` is whether Claude Code's Glob honours .gitignore (the session's settings env has CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE=false, as every fresh host launch does), and a vector may override it. `cwd` is the session working directory: what a Grep/Glob call with no path searches, and where an OpenCode `shell` call without `workdir` starts. `shell_cwd` (Claude Code Bash only) is the folder the command starts in, as Claude Code reports it; absent, it is unknown. Tools: Claude Code's Bash, Grep, Glob; OpenCode's shell, grep, glob. expect: refuse | allow; `root` is the root a refusal names; `message`, when present, is the exact refusal text.
